snippet.title: Tabletop Tavern: Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Demo Now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3337380/Tabletop_Tavern

Hey guys, been working on this new game for the past 5ish months. Demo is out now to see what people think about it and help me build on it. Any suggestions or comments hit me with on twitter or discord.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/cSnj42XCy5 
See Daily Updates on Twitter: https://twitter.com/TJGameDev 
Contact me for freelance work: TJ@memoristudios.com
Check out the Synty store by using my affiliate link to support the channel! https://syntystore.com/?ref:TJ
Play my previous game Castles on Clouds on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1668620/Castles_on_Clouds


About me -
Hi I'm TJ, an indie developer primarily developing games in the Unity Engine. I left a career in software to focus on my passion of game dev and am enjoying every moment of it.

Software Used -  
Unity Version: 2021.1.22f1
Visual Studio Code: https://code.visualstudio.com/ 
Adobe Premiere Pro: https://www.adobe.com/products/premier
Adobe Photoshop: https://www.adobe.com/products/photoshop

Music:
Legendary Epic Heroic Cinematic Music | Heroic by Alex-Productions | https://onsound.eu/
Music promoted by https://www.free-stock-music.com
Creative Commons / Attribution 3.0 Unported License (CC BY 3.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/deed.en_US

PC Specs - 
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 
AMD Ryzen 7 2700x 
64GB RAM
Way too much caffeine
